projects.title: Offline Password Manager with Network Security Protocols and Desktop Application
projects.description:
This project was to remedy the cyber security faults of using a cloud-based password manager, by creating a microcontroller device to act as a password manager that: 

1) Maintained an encrypted password storage that is completely disconnected from the internet eliminating the need for users to entrust password storage to the cloud or an internet-connected device. 

2) Replaced the single-factor master password concept with a 2-factor system of performing user authentication and password retrieval: one being the possession of the device itself, and the other being biometric authentication using a fingerprint sensor. This authentication scheme would be a more secure and responsive master password. 

3) Allowed a computer to request passwords from the device via either encrypted data sent over Bluetooth connection (for speed and convenience), or a wired USB connection (to eliminate the need to even trust the wireless communication).  

I was also responsible for developing an accompanying desktop application will be created to interface with the device from the receiving computer, allowing the user to also manage password storage, creation, and retrieval without the need for an on-board user interface.
